column1: This book will provide a detailed examination of the Little Ice Age and other climatic shifts, but, before I embark on that, let me provide a historical context.
column2: 本书将详细考察小冰期及其他气候变化。不过，在展开讨论之前，我先介绍一下历史背景。

column1: We tend to think of climate - as opposed to weather - as something unchanging, yet humanity has been at the mercy of climate change for its entire existence, with at least eight glacial episodes in the past 730,000 years.
column2: 我们往往把气候看作某种恒定的东西，并将它与天气区别开来。然而，自人类出现以来，人类就一直受气候变化支配。在过去73万年间，就至少经历了八次冰期。

column1: Our ancestors adapted to the universal but irregular global warming since the end of the last great Ice Age, around 10,000 years ago, with dazzling opportunism.
column2: 大约一万年前，上一次大冰期结束。此后，全球普遍变暖，进程却并不均匀；我们的祖先以惊人的应变能力适应了这一变化。
column9: opportunism|n. 因势而变、抓住时机的本领

column1: They developed strategies for surviving harsh drought cycles, decades of heavy rainfall or unaccustomed cold; adopted agriculture and stock-raising, which revolutionised human life; and founded the world’s first pre-industrial civilisations in Egypt, Mesopotamia and the Americas.
column2: 他们想方设法熬过一轮轮严酷的干旱、持续数十年的强降雨或罕见的严寒；他们开始种地、饲养牲畜，彻底改变了人类生活；还在埃及、美索不达米亚和美洲创立了世界上最早的前工业文明。

column1: But the price of sudden climate change, in famine, disease and suffering, was often high.
column2: 但气候骤变常常让人付出高昂的代价，带来饥荒、疾病和苦难。

column1: The Little Ice Age lasted from roughly 1300 until the middle of the nineteenth century.
column2: 小冰期大约从1300年持续到19世纪中叶。

column1: Only two centuries ago, Europe experienced a cycle of bitterly cold winters; mountain glaciers in the Swiss Alps were the lowest in recorded memory, and pack ice surrounded Iceland for much of the year.
column2: 就在两个世纪前，欧洲还经历过一连串严寒的冬季；瑞士阿尔卑斯山的冰川下延至有记录以来的最低处，一年中有很长一段时间，冰岛周围都被浮冰包围。
column12: for much of the year|在一年中的很长一段时间

column1: The climatic events of the Little Ice Age did more than help shape the modern world.
column2: 小冰期的气候变化不仅参与塑造了现代世界。

column1: They are the deeply important context for the current unprecedented global warming.
column2: 这些变化也是理解当今这场前所未有的全球变暖极其重要的背景。

column1: The Little Ice Age was far from a deep freeze, however; rather an irregular seesaw of rapid climatic shifts, few lasting more than a quarter-century, driven by complex and still little understood interactions between the atmosphere and the ocean.
column2: 不过，小冰期远非一段严寒不变的时期。气候在短时间内反复变化，毫无规律，单次变化很少持续超过二十五年。其背后的驱动力是大气与海洋之间复杂的相互作用，人们至今对这些作用仍知之甚少。

column1: The seesaw brought cycles of intensely cold winters and easterly winds, then switched abruptly to years of heavy spring and early summer rains, mild winters, and frequent Atlantic storms, or to periods of droughts, light northeasterly winds, and summer heat waves.
column2: 这种反复波动带来了一轮轮严寒的冬季和东风，随后又突然转为春季和初夏雨量大、冬季温和、大西洋风暴频发的年景，或是干旱、东北风微弱而夏季热浪来袭的时期。

column1: Reconstructing the climate changes of the past is extremely difficult, because systematic weather observations began only a few centuries ago, in Europe and North America.
column2: 重建过去的气候变化极其困难，因为系统的气象观测直到几个世纪前才在欧洲和北美开始。

column1: Records from India and tropical Africa are even more recent.
column2: 印度和非洲热带地区的气象记录开始得更晚。

column1: For the time before records began, we have only ‘proxy records’ reconstructed largely from tree rings and ice cores, supplemented by a few incomplete written accounts.
column2: 对于有气象记录以前的时期，我们只有“代用记录”。这些记录主要根据树木年轮和冰芯重建，并以少量不完整的文字记载作为补充。

column1: We now have hundreds of tree-ring records from throughout the northern hemisphere, and many from south of the equator, too, amplified with a growing body of temperature data from ice cores drilled in Antarctica, Greenland, the Peruvian Andes, and other locations.
column2: 我们如今已有数百份来自北半球各地的树木年轮记录，赤道以南也有许多。从南极洲、格陵兰、秘鲁安第斯山脉等地钻取的冰芯，还提供了越来越多的气温数据，补充了这些记录。
column9: a growing body of|越来越多的

column1: We are close to a knowledge of annual summer and winter temperature variations over much of the northern hemisphere going back 600 years.
column2: 我们已接近弄清过去六百年间，北半球大部分地区每年夏季和冬季的气温变化。
column6: over much of|在……大部分地区

column1: This book is a narrative history of climatic shifts during the past ten centuries, and some of the ways in which people in Europe adapted to them.
column2: 本书叙述了过去十个世纪的气候变化，以及欧洲人适应这些变化的一些方式。
column3: narrative history|叙事性的历史记述
column6: past ten centuries|过去十个世纪

column1: Part One describes the Medieval Warm Period, roughly 900 to 1200.
column2: 第一部分介绍中世纪暖期，大约从公元900年到1200年。
column4: Medieval Warm Period|n. 中世纪暖期

column1: During these three centuries, Norse voyagers from Northern Europe explored northern seas, settled Greenland, and visited North America.
column2: 这三个世纪里，来自北欧的斯堪的纳维亚航海者探索了北方海域，在格陵兰定居，还到过北美。
column5: Norse|adj. 古斯堪的纳维亚人的

column1: It was not a time of uniform warmth, for then, as always since the Great Ice Age, there were constant shifts in rainfall and temperature.
column2: 那个时期并非始终温暖。和大冰期结束以来的其他时候一样，当时的降雨量和气温不断变化。

column1: Mean European temperatures were about the same as today, perhaps slightly cooler.
column2: 当时欧洲的平均气温与今天大致相同，也许略低一些。
column5: about the same as|与……大致相同

column1: It is known that the Little Ice Age cooling began in Greenland and the Arctic in about 1200.
column2: 我们知道，小冰期的降温大约于1200年在格陵兰和北极地区开始。
column3: It is known that|人们已知

column1: As the Arctic ice pack spread southward, Norse voyages to the west were rerouted into the open Atlantic, then ended altogether.
column2: 随着北极浮冰向南扩展，北欧航海者向西航行时改走大西洋开阔海域，后来西航完全停止。

column1: Storminess increased in the North Atlantic and North Sea.
column2: 北大西洋和北海的风暴活动加剧。

column1: Colder, much wetter weather descended on Europe between 1315 and 1319, when thousands perished in a continent-wide famine.
column2: 1315年至1319年间，欧洲的天气变得更冷，降水也多得多。其间，数千人在一场席卷全欧洲的饥荒中丧生。

column1: By 1400, the weather had become decidedly more unpredictable and stormier, with sudden shifts and lower temperatures that culminated in the cold decades of the late sixteenth century.
column2: 到1400年，天气已明显更加难以预测，风暴也更多了。天气骤变，气温下降，最终在16世纪末那几十年里冷到了极点。

column1: Fish were a vital commodity in growing towns and cities, where food supplies were a constant concern.
column2: 在不断发展的城镇里，鱼是至关重要的商品，因为食物供应始终是人们关心的问题。

column1: Dried cod and herring were already the staples of the European fish trade, but changes in water temperatures forced fishing fleets to work further offshore.
column2: 鳕鱼干和鲱鱼原已是欧洲鱼类贸易的主要商品，但水温的变化迫使各支渔船队到离岸更远的海域作业。

column1: The Basques, Dutch, and English developed the first offshore fishing boats adapted to a colder and stormier Atlantic.
column2: 巴斯克人、荷兰人和英格兰人造出了首批能适应更寒冷、风暴更多的大西洋海况的离岸渔船。

column1: A gradual agricultural revolution in northern Europe stemmed from concerns over food supplies at a time of rising populations.
column2: 在人口增长之际，人们对粮食供应的担忧促成了北欧一场逐步展开的农业革命。

column1: The revolution involved intensive commercial farming and the growing of animal fodder on land not previously used for crops.
column2: 这场革命包括实行集约化商品农业，以及在过去未种庄稼的土地上种植牲畜饲料。

column1: The increased productivity from farmland made some countries self-sufficient in grain and livestock and offered effective protection against famine.
column2: 农田生产力的提高使一些国家在谷物和牲畜方面实现了自给，也使它们能够有效抵御饥荒。

column1: Global temperatures began to rise slowly after 1850, with the beginning of the Modern Warm Period.
column2: 1850年以后，随着现代暖期开始，全球气温缓慢上升。
column8: Modern Warm Period|n. 现代暖期

column1: There was a vast migration from Europe by land-hungry farmers and others, to which the famine caused by the Irish potato blight contributed, to North America, Australia, New Zealand, and southern Africa.
column2: 渴求土地的农民和其他人从欧洲大规模移居北美、澳大利亚、新西兰和非洲南部。爱尔兰马铃薯晚疫病引起的饥荒也是促成这波移民潮的因素之一。

column1: Millions of hectares of forest and woodland fell before the newcomers’ axes between 1850 and 1890, as intensive European farming methods expanded across the world.
column2: 1850年至1890年间，随着欧洲的集约化耕作方式向世界各地扩展，这些新来者挥斧砍倒了数百万公顷的森林和林地。

column1: The unprecedented land clearance released vast quantities of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere, triggering for the first time humanly caused global warming.
column2: 这场规模空前的土地清垦向大气释放了大量二氧化碳，首次引发了由人类活动造成的全球变暖。
column10: humanly caused|由人类活动造成的

column1: Temperatures climbed more rapidly in the twentieth century as the use of fossil fuels proliferated and greenhouse gas levels continued to soar.
column2: 到了20世纪，随着化石燃料的使用日益普遍、大气中温室气体的含量不断猛增，气温上升得更快了。

column1: The rise has been even steeper since the early 1980s.
column2: 自20世纪80年代初以来，升温的势头更猛了。

column1: The Little Ice Age has given way to a new climatic regime, marked by prolonged and steady warming.
column2: 小冰期已经过去，接替它的是一种新的气候状态，其特征是长期而持续的变暖。

column1: At the same time, extreme weather events like Category 5 hurricanes are becoming more frequent.
column2: 与此同时，五级飓风等极端天气事件也越来越频繁。
column3: At the same time|与此同时
column4: extreme weather events|极端天气事件
